title: inula limonella
intro: Inula limonella, commonly known as the Limonella Daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, wounds, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Inula limonella include soothing and calming effects, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
